title: The Glasshouse of Room 214
author: Silas Amberdale
blurb: August Montrose, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
